name: Pre-signing release artifact tampering
description: Model unauthorized modification of a release binary during package assembly before digital signing, causing the distributed artifact to contain attacker-controlled code while potentially retaining a valid signature from the legitimate publisher.

placeholders.RELEASE_ARTIFACT: path to the release artifact selected for modification
placeholders.ORIGINAL_ARTIFACT: the legitimate artifact content or artifact reference before modification
placeholders.RELEASE_ARTIFACT_GLOB: project-relative glob identifying eligible release artifacts

preconditions: project has a release packaging process that assembles distributable artifacts
the attacker can modify an artifact before the signing stage
the packaging pipeline includes the modified artifact in the release
the placement engine supports release artifact replacement
